correctness.rationale: Euler-tour iff balance plus connected positive support gives complete realizability. Four disjoint bridge cases have exact parameterizations; geometric sums yield the rational GF, partial fractions yield the closed formula and pole orders prove minimal quasiperiod 12. A standalone checker directly enumerates all words through n=17 and crosschecks coefficients through n=84. No step infers the infinite theorem solely from finite experiments.
